labels.Вход и выход присоединяемого ядра: Input and output of an attached core
labels.Слева собранный фрагмент с выходом a,b,: Left: an assembled fragment with output a,b. Right: a new core with input a,b and output c,d. The core's input and output pairs are disjoint. Edge ab belongs only to the left fragment, and cd only to the core. After gluing, the active boundary moves from a,b to c,d; this requires a separate transformation of minors.
labels.Порядок пар фиксирован: вход (a, b), вых: Ordered pairs: input (a, b), output (c, d). The diagram specifies incidence.
labels.Общее ребро ab учитывается один раз: его: The shared edge ab is counted once: it belongs to the left fragment.
labels.Сочленить на (a, b) и перенести паспорт: Gluing at (a, b) and moving the passport to (c, d) are separate operations.
labels.Граничный отклик P₅ и остовной масштаб: Boundary response of P₅ and spanning-tree scale
labels.Исходный единичный путь a-b-c-d-e имеет: The original unit-weight path a-b-c-d-e has boundary a,c,e, spanning-tree coefficient 1, and fully separated grove weight 4. Eliminating b,d leaves the path a-c-e with conductances 1/2,1/2 and spanning-tree coefficient 1/4. Boundary resistances 2,2,4 are preserved; scale 4 recovers the original value 1.
labels.Граница B = {a, c, e}; все исходные пров: Boundary B = {a, c, e}; all original conductances are 1.
labels.δ = 4: четыре рощи состояния a|c|e: δ = 4: four groves of state a|c|e
labels.Исключение сохраняет граничную метрику,: Elimination preserves the boundary metric; the spanning-tree scale is retained separately.
labels.Два P₅ и остовное сочленение: Two copies of P₅ and spanning-tree gluing
labels.Два единичных пути a-b1-c-d1-e и a-b2-c-: Two unit-weight paths a-b1-c-d1-e and a-b2-c-d2-e are identified at a,c,e. Green edges belong to the first part, blue to the second. The result is two four-cycles sharing c. Each gives four trees, for 16 in total. The result's Gram matrix is half that of one part, while the spanning-tree coefficient uses the determinant of the sum.
labels.Общая граница B = {a, c, e}; внутренние: Shared boundary B = {a, c, e}; internal vertices are distinct, and no edges are shared.
labels.По грамианам: τ₁τ₂ det(G₁ + G₂) = det(2G: From Gram matrices: τ₁τ₂ det(G₁ + G₂) = det(2G₁) = 16
labels.Грамиан самого сочленения: G = G₁/2. Вс: Gram matrix of the gluing itself: G = G₁/2. All boundary resistances are halved.
labels.Единичные пути a-x-b и a-y-b соединяются: Unit-weight paths a-x-b and a-y-b are joined at matching a,b; internal vertices x,y are distinct. The result is the cycle a-x-b-y-a. Only selecting both entire paths creates a cycle. The polynomial is (1+t)^4-t^4.
labels.Общая граница B = {a, b}; все рёбра имею: Shared boundary B = {a, b}; all edges have distinct labels and unit weights.
labels.Полный набор - цикл: The full set is a cycle
labels.Из 16 подмножеств рёбер допустимы 15; ис: Of 16 edge subsets, 15 are admissible; only the complete edge set is excluded.
labels.Сетка трёх выборов слева: пустой набор,: A grid of three choices on the left: the empty set, ab, bc; and three on the right: the empty set, cd, de. There is one edgeless forest, four with one edge, and four with two edges. The last four are groves.
labels.Строки: выбор на a-b-c. Столбцы: выбор н: Rows: choices on a-b-c. Columns: choices on c-d-e. All weights are 1.
Purple: an internal component. Dashed line: an unselected edge.
labels.Одно общее ребро или две его копии: One shared edge or two copies
labels.Два единичных треугольника a-u-b-a и a-v: Two unit-weight triangles a-u-b-a and a-v-b-a are glued at a,b. Left: the shared instance ab is retained once, giving five edges. Right: two distinct instances of ab remain in parallel, giving six edges. Edges do not cross away from vertices.
labels.Исходные компоненты: треугольники a-u-b-: Original components: triangles a-u-b-a and a-v-b-a; all weights are 1.
labels.Для одного общего ребра: L = L₁ + L₂ − L: For one shared edge: L = L₁ + L₂ − Lₑ
labels.Если ab принадлежит только одной компоне: If ab belongs to only one component, use the law for disjoint edge sets.
labels.Один партнёр и две разметки пути: One partner and two markings of a path
labels.Партнёр J содержит единичное ребро xy и: Partner J contains the unit edge xy and isolated boundary vertex z. Attaching it to x-b-y-d-z gives a triangle with a tail; attaching it to x-b-z-d-y gives the cycle C5. No edges are shared; names x,y,z are identified.
labels.B = {x, y, z}; отождествляются одноимённ: B = {x, y, z}; match vertices by name and count each edge once.
labels.Одинаковые лесные полиномы частей дают р: Equal forest polynomials of the parts give different polynomials after gluing.
labels.Путь abcd и звезда с центром b. В обоих: The path abcd and a star centered at b. Both have ordered boundary a,b and unit conductances. Their forest state polynomials coincide, while their characteristic polynomials differ.
labels.Граница (a, b) выделена золотым; все про: Boundary (a, b) is marked in gold; all conductances are 1.
labels.В обоих случаях: ℱa|b(t) = (1 + t)²;: In both cases:  ℱa|b(t) = (1 + t)²;   ℱab(t) = t(1 + t)²
labels.Два ребра в лесе: f₂ = 3, но корневые ко: Two-edge forests: f₂ = 3, but rooted coefficients p₂ are 10 and 9.
labels.Паспорт по связности границы не сохраняе: A boundary-connectivity passport does not retain all component sizes.
labels.Одинаковый отклик и разные лесные паспор: The same response, different forest passports
labels.В обоих графах граница a,b, внутренние л: Both graphs have boundary a,b, internal leaves x,y attached to a, and a unit edge ab. The first has ax,ay weights 1,1; the second has weights 2,1/2. Both have tau=delta=R_ab=1 and identical grove weights. Separated-state polynomials are (1+t)^2 and (1+2t)(1+t/2), so their full passports differ.
labels.B = {a, b}; оба графа имеют четыре верши: B = {a, b}; both graphs have four vertices and the same topology.
labels.В обоих графах резистенс между a и b рав: Both graphs have resistance 1 between a and b;  τ = δ = 1
labels.Все веса рощ совпадают; младшие лесные к: All grove weights agree; lower forest coefficients differ.
labels.Лист без выбранного ребра становится вну: A leaf without its edge is an internal component and cannot occur in a grove.
labels.Петля и параллельные рёбра после стягива: A loop and parallel edges after contraction
labels.Треугольник с проводимостями ab=2, ac=3,: A triangle with conductances ab=2, ac=3, bc=5. Identifying a=b turns ab into a loop of weight 2 and ac,bc into parallel edges of weights 3,5. The loop is excluded from forests. The parallel pair can be replaced by one edge of weight 8; the forest polynomial is 1+8t.
labels.Отождествляем a и b в h; метки и веса рё: Identify a and b as h; initially retain edge labels and weights.
labels.Из параллельной пары можно выбрать не бо: Select at most one edge from the parallel pair.
labels.Член 15t² означал бы цикл из двух рёбер: The term 15t² would be a two-edge cycle, so it is excluded.
labels.Путь P₅ с трёхточечной границей: Path P₅ with a three-point boundary
labels.Путь a-b-c-d-e с единичными проводимостя: Path a-b-c-d-e with unit conductances. The boundary is a,c,e; b,d are internal vertices.
B = {a, c, e}; all conductances are 1.
labels.Золотые окружности: граница. Внутренние: Gold circles: boundary. Internal vertices: b, d.
labels.Каждый остовной лес сохраняет все пять в: Every spanning forest retains all five vertices.
labels.Пятнадцать состояний четырёхточечной гра: Fifteen states of a four-point boundary
labels.Все разбиения a,b,c,d в фиксированном ци: All partitions of a,b,c,d in a fixed cyclic order. Rank counts are 1,6,7,1. The only crossing partition, ac|bd, is marked in pink. Colored regions are blocks, not edges; their crossing is not a vertex.
labels.Циклический порядок a, b, c, d. Области: Cyclic order a, b, c, d. Regions represent blocks, not graph edges.
labels.15 исходных состояний → 14 координат кла: 15 original states → 14 coordinates of the passport class
labels.Пять разбиений границы {a, c, e}: Five partitions of the boundary {a, c, e}
labels.Пять формальных состояний: ace, ac|e, ae: Five formal states: ace, ac|e, ae|c, a|ce, a|c|e. Colored regions represent blocks, not edges. State ae|c is impossible on P5.
labels.Расположение трёх вершин одинаково; меня: The three vertex positions stay fixed; only the partition into blocks changes.
labels.Цветные области - блоки разбиения; они н: Colored regions are partition blocks; they do not depict graph edges.
labels.Различимые копии и одно общее ребро: Distinct copies and one shared edge
labels.Слева после отождествления a,b сохранены: Left: after identifying a,b, two unit edge copies remain, green e1 and blue e2. Their forest polynomial is 1+2t; they cannot both be selected. Right: one shared unit edge e remains, with polynomial 1+t. Summing parallel weights would give weight 2, not 1.
labels.Соответствие вершин одинаково: a ↔ a, b: The vertex match is the same: a ↔ a, b ↔ b. The edge-counting rule changes.
labels.Сумма проводимостей параллельных копий р: The parallel copies have total conductance 2.
labels.Для одного общего ребра его метку заране: For one shared edge, assign its label to exactly one part in advance.
labels.Матрица в порядке x|y|z, xy|z, xz|y, x|y: Matrix in the order x|y|z, xy|z, xz|y, x|yz, xyz. Rows: 11111, 10110, 11010, 11100, 10000. One means a forest; zero means a cycle. Distinct pair states are compatible; identical pair states create a cycle.
labels.B = {x, y, z}; порядок строк и столбцов: B = {x, y, z}; rows and columns follow the passport coordinate order.
labels.1: объединение остаётся лесом; 0: объед: 1: the union remains a forest;  0: the union creates a cycle
labels.Разные парные связи дают дерево на грани: Distinct pair connections give a boundary tree; a repeated connection gives a cycle.
labels.Полностью соединённое состояние xyz совм: The fully connected state xyz is compatible only with x|y|z.
labels.Сокращённая матрица: леса и остовные бло: Reduced matrix: forests and spanning-tree blocks
labels.Матрица совместимости четырнадцати непер: Compatibility matrix of fourteen noncrossing states in the note's order. Blue marks ones at rank sum 3, green marks ones at smaller sums. Larger rank sums have only zeros. Group sizes are 1,6,6,1; antidiagonal blocks 1,A,A transpose,1 are nonsingular. det A=8, det C=-64.
labels.Порядок состояний соответствует формуле: State order follows formula (4). Colored cell = 1; white cell = 0.
labels.det A = 8; det сокращённой матрицы = −6: det A = 8;  det of the reduced matrix = −64 ≠ 0
labels.Для k вершин побочная блочная диагональ: For k vertices, the block antidiagonal is specified by r + s = k − 1.
labels.Граф G имеет четыре граничные вершины и: Graph G has four boundary vertices and unit edges ac,bd; their crossing is not a vertex. Partner J adds only ab. Boundary names match and no edges are shared. The gluing is the path c-a-b-d, with forest polynomial (1+t)^3. Deleting state ac|bd loses t^2+t^3, while linear replacement retains the full answer.
labels.B = {a, b, c, d}; все веса равны 1. Отож: B = {a, b, c, d}; all weights are 1. Match names; no edges are shared.
The edges have no shared vertex.
J adds the blue edge ab.
labels.Вклад t² · s(ac|bd) переносится в семь к: The term t² · s(ac|bd) moves to seven coordinates:
labels.Это линейные координаты, а не веса отдел: These are linear coordinates, not weights of individual states.
labels.Если просто удалить ac|bd, получится 1 +: Simply deleting ac|bd gives 1 + 3t + 2t² instead of (1 + t)³.
labels.Два пути сочленяются в цикл C₄: Two paths glued into the cycle C₄
labels.Пути a-u-b и a-v-b с единичными проводим: Paths a-u-b and a-v-b have unit conductances and common boundary a,b. Identifying a with a and b with b gives the cycle a-u-b-v-a. No edges are shared. Each boundary diagonal has one excess xi term subtracted.
labels.Отождествляются a ↔ a и b ↔ b; внутренни: Identify a ↔ a and b ↔ b; internal vertices u, v are distinct.
labels.При ξ = 2 рациональные Sᵢ не определены;: At ξ = 2, the rational Sᵢ are undefined; the polynomial law remains valid.
labels.Рёбра ab,bc обязательны. Справа выбран п: Edges ab,bc are required. On the right, select the empty set, cd, or de. The first forest has internal component d and contributes t^2; the other two are groves and each contributes t^3.
labels.Во всех трёх лесах a соединена с c, а e: In all three forests, a is connected to c and e lies in another component.
labels.Полином состояния: t² + t³ + t³ = t²(1 +: State polynomial: t² + t³ + t³ = t²(1 + 2t).
labels.Три стягивания границы пути P₅: Three contractions of the boundary of P₅
labels.Путь a-b-c-d-e имеет границу a,c,e и еди: Path a-b-c-d-e has boundary a,c,e and unit weights. Identifying a=c gives a weight-2 connection h-b and the path h-d-e; a=e gives the cycle C4; a=c=e gives weight-2 connections h-b and h-d. The polynomials are (1+2t)(1+t)^2, (1+t)^4-t^4, and (1+2t)^2, respectively.
labels.B = {a, c, e}; исходные проводимости рав: B = {a, c, e}; original conductances are 1. Boundary vertices are gold.
labels.Два параллельных единичных ребра заменен: Two parallel unit edges are replaced by a connection of conductance 2.
labels.Полиномы учитывают все остовные леса, вк: Polynomials count all spanning forests, including those with internal components.
labels.Цикл между двумя стягиваемыми блоками: A cycle between two contracted blocks
labels.Исходный лес содержит ac и bd. Золотой п: The original forest contains ac and bd. Gold dashed lines ab and cd specify two identification blocks. After contraction, the selected edges form a parallel pair between h1 and h2, hence a cycle.
labels.π = ac|bd; σ = ab|cd. Отдельные блоки: π = ac|bd;  σ = ab|cd. Individual blocks pass the test; the whole system fails.
labels.Пунктир задаёт отождествления и не являе: Dashed lines specify identifications, not edges of the original graph.
